description: Create a task requiring a human operator to deliver credentials (account login, API key, phone verification code, etc.) via an end-to-end encrypted channel. A unique ECDH keypair is generated automatically — only you can decrypt the result. The server never sees plaintext credentials. IMPORTANT: Save the returned private_key — you need it to call retrieve_credential later.

callback_secret.description: Optional secret to sign webhook callbacks

callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL for status updates

description.description: Detailed description of what credentials are needed

idempotency_key.description: Optional key to make task creation safe to retry

proof_requirements.description: List of proof requirements (e.g., 'screenshot of account creation')

reward_usd.description: Reward in USD for the operator

title.description: Short title for the credential task

name: dispatch_credential_task
